newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares plunge on dumping, recovery possible.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares plunge on dumping, recovery possible.

text.p: Danish share prices closed decidely lower on Thursday after plunging on foreign investor dumping, with dealers seeing possible recovery by the weekend provided the U.S. stock and bond markets hold up.

"I think the market could well recover if Wall Street does not decline too much tonight. After a breather, we could well see a revival tomorrow if foreign investors look more positively on Danish shares," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index closed 4.28 point down at 153.75 in overall bourse turnover of 1.244 billion crowns.
The KFX March future fell 3.30 point to 154.20 with 1,159 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
A.P. Moeller's D/S 1912 and D/S Svendborg both shed 6,500 crowns to finish at 193,500 and 278,000 respectively.
Tele Danmark dropped 15 to 326 in 200,000 share turnover.
